semiconductor_relevance: High — Attach Point Co., LTD specializes in advanced semiconductor packaging equipment, particularly in die bonding and wafer-level bonding technologies.
summary: Attach Point Co., LTD is a global manufacturer of high-technology equipment focused on advanced semiconductor packaging systems, including thermo-compression bonders and wafer-level hybrid bonding. Their solutions are primarily utilized in high-bandwidth memory, high-performance CPUs/GPUs, and advanced packaging for AI chips.
